name: pani puri
ingredients_raw: Pani Puri Pellets: Refined Wheat flour (Maida), Corn Flour, Rice Flour, Salt, Raising Agent - INS500(ii) and Edible Vegetable oil - Refined Palmolein oil. Mint Chutney Paste: Water, Mint (23%), Coriander, Green Chilli, Salt, Black Salt, Ginger, Lemon, Acidity Regulator INS 330 and Stabilizer INS 415. CONTAINS PERMITTED CLASS II PRESERVATIVE INS 211 Sweet Tamarind-Dates Chutney Paste: Sugar, Water, Tamarind (16%), Dates (4%), Salt, Red Chilli powder, Acidity Regulator INS330 and Ajowan. CONTAINS PERMITTED CLASS II PRESERVATIVE INS 211 Seasoning: Red Chilli powder, Salt, Coriander powder, Black Salt, Acidity Regulator INS 330 and Turmeric powder.
